content: {"episode_id":"ep-05043","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring, for episode ep-05043. The clinical indication note states the patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of symptomatic atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome, supporting diagnosis codes I48.91, I49.5, and I49.9. The note further documents a history of unexplained cardiac arrhythmias and the need to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances, for which mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture continuous electrocardiographic data during daily activities. We request reconsideration of the denial on the basis of this documented medical necessity."}
